description:
Filed by s527c (2026-10-31).  The EMISSION of perl's cpan/CPAN/lib/CPAN/FirstTime.pm is NOT REPRODUCIBLE: the #2610 detector table rows for its `prompt(...)` calls (lines 887, 989, 1198, ... 2125; 25 rows) read `"proto:$;$"` in some runs and `"list-call"` in others, with the SAME compiler and the SAME input; the `prompt` call bodies differ with them (e.g. a `(p-scalar (p-string-concat ...))` argument at the `Would you like me to append that to $rc now?` call in the proto runs).

Measured (s527c, 2026-10-31 00:4x-01:0x, box loaded by three agents): tools/emission-ab.pl --ref 328ebf64 over 107 files flagged FirstTime.pm DIFF (A=proto, B=list-call); a one-file re-run DIFF again; base-x (main ff5f72b5 + vendor dc242138) read 25 proto rows once and 0 in the next six runs; an extraction of 328ebf64 read 25 via probe.sh at 00:4x and 0 at 01:0x; PERL_HASH_SEED 0..7 all 0 (not hash order).  So the answer depends on time / box state, not on the compiler commit.

perl: `sub prompt ($;$)` is at line 2194, BELOW every call, so each call compiles as a plain LIST call (perl warns "called too early to check prototype") -- `list-call` is perl's reading (#2871 position-aware prototypes); the `proto:$;$` runs apply a prototype above its definition.

Suspect: something the prototype lookup reads that is not the input file (the module cache under ~/.pcl-cache shared by every tree, or a module-prototype extraction of ExtUtils::MakeMaker / CPAN::Shell with a time-dependent outcome).  Cheap discriminating measurement: run the transpile twice with PCL_CACHE_DIR=<fresh dir> vs the shared cache, and strace -e openat one proto run vs one list-call run to see which file the proto run read.


=== s533b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-03): two more reproducers of the same flip, found by a wide emission A/B ===
The #2610 detector table's call KIND for one call site differs between two runs of the SAME compiler on the same file (both on main 4fb60297's extraction, measured by repeated `pl2cl` runs, no code change involved):
  perl t/op/coreamp.t line 401: ("Hash::Util" "bucket_ratio" 401 "unknown") in 1 of 8 runs, "list-call" in the others.
  ~/.cpan/build/Getopt-Long-2.58-0/lib/Getopt/Long.pm (--module) lines 1409/1422/1436/1455: ("Getopt::Long" "setup_pa_args" N "proto:$@") in 1 of 4 runs, "list-call" in the others.
Each showed as an unpredicted DIFF in s533b's emission A/B vs 4fb60297 (base side happened to draw the minority answer); neither file's emission is touched by the s533b change.  A compiler that emits differently on the same input keeps undermining corpus-diff / emission-ab: an A/B reader must re-run the base side before calling such a DIFF.


=== DONE (s532d) -- code + guard done; the POPULATION bar was in flight at the s535 checkpoint ===
CAUSE (measured): NOT hash order -- PERL_HASH_SEED 1..7 agree; the flip is CACHE STATE.  `pl2cl --module` of CPAN/FirstTime.pm (lib 5.40.3): seed 0 on a cold Pl::ProtoCache = 28 proto rows, seeds 1-7 warm = 3, two fresh PCL_CACHE_DIRs = 28 (scratch/s532d/seeds.sh in the s532d worktree).  Reduced (scratch/s532d/pr/nd, nd2): a module that imports prompt($;$) and declares its own `sub prompt ($;$)` BELOW its calls.  The walk's prototype flags are perl core booleans; Pl::ProtoCache stored them as JSON false/true and JSON::PP decoded them as JSON::PP::Boolean OBJECTS, so Environment::_proto_shape_key saw a cached record and a walked one as DIFFERENT prototypes -- and _sited_record's "a re-registration of the SAME prototype keeps the EARLIER site" rule answered differently cold (walked: same shape, the import's site wins, proto above the definition) and warm (cached: different shape, the definition's own site, list-call).
FIX 1 (the nondeterminism): Pl::ProtoCache::_json sets boolean_values(!!0, !!1) (JSON::PP >= 4.0; guarded by ->can): a record reads back as the data the walk produced.
FIX 2 (the deterministic answer was then the WRONG one for `use M ()`): _merge_module_prototypes merged every codegen-relevant prototype of M for an EMPTY import list -- `use M ()` calls no import in perl.  `none => 1` from Pl::Parser::use_imports_nothing (the literal empty parens only; `use M qw()` and `use M` still import), both lowering paths (Parser.pm's v1 use arm, Parser2's use-statement pre-pass); the per-package stash facts stay.
RESULT: FirstTime.pm byte-identical over seeds 0..7 + two fresh caches (1803a2be); 26 proto rows remain: 25 prompt() rows below line 866's `require CPAN::Nox` = #4324 (filed: a `require NAME` merges flat too) + 1 CPAN::HandleConfig `()` row.  perl-tests/hash.t (corpus-diff's one differing file, twice): the BASE flips cold 2dede883 / warm 69edb821, the tree is cold = warm = shared 67db3baf (= the base's COLD answer: ("Hash::Util" "bucket_ratio" 116 "unknown") where the base-warm reads "list-call"; perl knows nothing of Hash::Util at line 116, its require is at 137).
GUARD: Pl/t/proto-cache-01.t rows 13-16 (PCNdB `use PCNdA` -> proto:$;$ and PCNdC `use PCNdA ()` -> list-call, perl-probed B:2 / C:5; cold vs warm under two seeds byte-identical), inverse-verified on 06a4b8ba (13, 15, 16 fail there).
OWED: the population leg scratch/s532d/out/seedpop.log (scratch/s532d/seedpop.pl: 111 perl-tests + 52 lib .pm, 8 runs each, seed 0 cold) -- usable only if it ends with heavy.sh's END line; its last line is `SEEDPOP: N files, M identical ..., K differ` plus one NONDET line per differing file.
subject: CPAN/FirstTime.pm emission is not reproducible: prompt() call kind flips proto:$;$ / list-call between runs of the same compiler
